subject: Lighthouse with the S18 worker: installability + offline reload now pass; performance below 0.90 on every page (first load 296 KB)
body: With the Lighthouse context opted in to the worker (config blocks it by default since c988af2), the installability and offline-reload steps pass. Performance, same profile, shared tip: Today 0.87, chapter 0.79, Practice 0.84, Plan 0.87 (were 0.94-0.98 before f450393). Cause as in 133614: SyncStatus in the shell brings the outbox, Dexie and entity APIs into the first load (initial JS 296 KB, limit 250). Moving them behind first paint should restore the scores; I will re-measure when it lands.
